quarterly_data.quarter: Mycronic press release: Interim Report January-September 2026 (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO comments (interim report): ASML and TSMC announced an industry initiative targeting a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031, supporting advanced-node production by 2033, which Pattern Generators is well positioned to benefit from. In Global Technologies the two largest business lines have a large order backlog and the focus is on maximizing production capacity; PCB manufacturers continued to increase investments, and Die Bonding saw healthy demand driven by AI infrastructure investments and aerospace & defense. In PCB Assembly Solutions the weak yen enabled Japanese competitors to be aggressive on price.
quarterly_data.figure: 12-inch mask pilot line targeted by 2031; advanced-node production by 2033
